summary: Three [CH][C][O]*+H* IS candidates and three intact [CH][C]OH* FS candidates passed local and remote handoff checks and were submitted as six AQCat25 adsorption pre-relaxations on MZ73; no VASP job was submitted.

payload.objective: Use AQCat25 GPU pre-relaxation to screen six Fe(110) endpoint candidates for [CH][C][O]* + H* -> [CH][C]OH* + * before any VASP adsorption relaxation or TS path work.
current_evidence: The candidate set contains three IS motifs and three FS motifs: eta3(C1,C2,O), eta2(C1,C2) with OH lifted, and kappa-C1 tilted.
All candidates retain Fe45, bottom 18 fixed atoms, 50-atom order Fe45-C2-O-H2, and the intended C1-C2/C2-O/C1-H connectivity; every FS retains O-H=0.971434 A.
All six work-to-GPU handoffs passed the active JSON Schema and bound-file validation locally and again on MZ73.
MZ73 jobs 1283-1288 were submitted with checkpoint SHA-256 e1f14d50590102dbdf64491a6ae328df6ba0ca2ebb947fbe72213820ae67eb50.
Initial scheduler evidence showed jobs 1283-1284 RUNNING and 1285-1288 PENDING.
payload.one_executable_step: Wait for MZ73 jobs 1283-1288 to finish, return every GPU artifact to work, then review convergence, connectivity, geometry, domain status, and duplicate classes before selecting any VASP candidates.
payload.submission_boundary: Only six MZ73 AQCat25 predicted-candidate pre-relaxations are authorized and submitted. No VASP adsorption, NEB, DIMER, frequency, or energy-registration action is authorized.
done_when: All six GPU jobs have terminal process and scheduler evidence.
Every returned structure and manifest passes work-side hash, geometry, chemistry, domain, and duplicate review.
A reviewable recommendation identifies which candidates, if any, should proceed to user-authorized VASP relaxation.
